description: A React component for a modal dialog that allows users to add, edit, view, and apply themes in the Apache Superset frontend. It includes form inputs for theme name and JSON configuration, validation, and integration with theme management hooks.

classes.name: ThemeModal
classes.description: A React functional component providing a modal interface for theme management, including creation, editing, validation, and application of themes.

methods.name: toEditorAnnotations
methods.description: Converts Ace editor annotations to the EditorAnnotation format used by the theme editor.

methods.name: useCallback functions (e.g., onSave, handleCancel, onApply)
methods.description: Various callback functions managing state updates, validation, and user interactions within the modal.

methods.name: useEffect hooks
methods.description: Handles initialization, resource fetching, validation, and side effects related to modal visibility and form state.
